rubrics.reason: All exact topics, counterevidence and distinct challenge completed in this run.

assessment.rationale: The reported group profit series and cash realization provide an economic anchor; the separately reviewed parent cash bridge and named finance/disposal alternatives expose specific, reviewable uncertainty rather than an unconstrained invented growth story. Parent deposit/dividend receipts, working-capital use and reinvestment assumptions still change distributable common value. These facts support material manageable uncertainty for this bounded FY2025 research thesis, not a narrow intrinsic-value range.

evidence.rationale: Four source-bound annual group profit observations remain positive; four-year cash realization is 96.18%. This supplies a reported economic anchor, not a forecast or confidence interval; the conditional parent model stays separate.

FY2025 parent WC cash use of 1.414952025062 trillion VND and current-tax versus cash-paid gap of 0.775375113368 trillion identify timing axes. Named other-finance/disposal cases and maintenance/reinvestment assumptions remain explicit; a mechanically broad DCF grid alone does not choose the band.

Parent income/cash depend on subsidiary distributions, deposits, WC and funded reinvestment. Reviewed standalone cash avoids guessed NCI allocation and double adding subsidiaries. Recurrence and the future distribution/maintenance policy remain conditional.

counterevidence.rationale: Parent cash realization is weaker than the group headline; continued WC use or adverse subsidiary distributions could widen future common-value uncertainty.

The source profile does not establish full-cycle sustainable common earnings or complete unknown fund leakage. Therefore 2/2 narrow supported range is rejected; no probabilistic bound or current share value is claimed.

disconfirmingEvidence: Parent cash realization is weaker than the group headline; continued WC use or adverse subsidiary distributions could widen future common-value uncertainty.

The source profile does not establish full-cycle sustainable common earnings or complete unknown fund leakage. Therefore 2/2 narrow supported range is rejected; no probabilistic bound or current share value is claimed.
assumptions: This is an issuer-specific current research judgment, not a statistical forecast interval or promise of future margins.
Standalone model inputs retain original conditional tax, reinvestment and subsidiary-income treatment; no new price/share denominator.
invalidationConditions: Material change in parent distribution receipts, WC/credit quality or finance-credit recurrence.
A source revision or economic event invalidates the stated earnings/cash anchor.

counterTests: Do not turn positive group profit or near-100% group cash conversion into a 2/2 intrinsic-value-confidence claim.
Keep parent cash and group historical figures separate; do not add subsidiary carrying values to parent cash models.
Known WC/tax/finance/distribution axes are source-bound; no newly invented demand or moat evidence.
Check distinct economic channel from BQ-CASH: forward-estimate precision rather than realized cash quality.
challengeDisposition.rationale: Accept 1/2 only for this bounded current-research thesis. Reported economic continuity and a reviewed parent cash bridge make the named WC/finance/reinvestment dependencies identifiable and reviewable, while incomplete sustainable common earnings, recurrence and fund completeness exclude 2/2 and a price-target acceptance. The band is an analyst judgment with medium confidence, not a statistical bound or an inference that all future risks are controlled.
